name: v1.4.0-beta.10 - Localized Report Export Build
body:
## DIT Pro v1.4.0-beta.10

### Focus

- Localize Rushes Log report exports so PDF, CSV, TSV, Excel, and clipboard TSV follow the current app language.
- Add source path, destination paths, total file count, completed/failed file count, video/audio/image/other media breakdown, and source release status to exported reports.
- Add Chinese-capable PDF font fallback so Chinese report labels render correctly on macOS.
- Fix beta update comparison so beta.7 is not treated as newer than beta.10.
- Fix Rushes Log save panel titles so PDF/CSV/TSV/Excel exports show the correct action name.
- Keep beta-channel version display and update metadata aligned with v1.4.0-beta.10.
- Sign, notarize, staple, and Gatekeeper-validate the macOS beta10 DMG with Developer ID Application: Negdims Inc. (7C3KJRTUK9).

### Known Issues

- TC207/TC209/TC212 remain pending before stable validation.
- Cloud upload is still experimental until the independent persistent cloud queue is completed.
- Chinese PDF export is functional, but current output embeds the full fallback CJK font and can produce large PDFs. Fix this with font subsetting or a Quartz/system-print PDF path before stable.
- Native macOS select menus and notification banners still require manual confirmation in several Computer Use-limited tests.
